before: The campaign is on, in its week, with some posts approved and scheduled.

steps.why: Read status first: active, so pause is legal. "Stop" means pause: reversible, and what people nearly always mean. Finish and retire are final and need their own ask.
The user's words are the yes for a pause. It stops new drafts only.
Pausing doesn't unschedule anything. Filter the rows yourself (status and filters sent here are ignored): Scheduled ones still go out at their times; undecided drafts just wait.

say: Paused Acme's Black Friday campaign: Bolta writes no more. 2 posts are still scheduled and will go out: Instagram Fri Nov 27 at 9:00 and Facebook Sat Nov 28 at 12:00. Move or delete either?
never: Saying the campaign is stopped without saying scheduled posts still go out.
Archiving or finishing it when the user said stop.
Deleting scheduled posts without a yes for each.
